intro: One double cheese beef burger is about 750 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the two beef patties and two cheese slices, followed by the bun and mayo.

variants.name: Set with fries and soft drink

diet: Yes, if you count it as one big main meal. The good part is it's high in protein. The problem usually comes from the set, with fries and a sweet drink adding another 500 kcal. Have just the burger with plain water, and it can still fit into your day.
tips: Order the burger alone, not the set. Drink plain water or a sugar-free drink.
Ask for less mayo or take out one cheese slice.
At a roadside stall, add salad and cucumber, and ask for less margarine on the bun.

swap.name: Single cheese beef burger with salad
swap.why: Still the burger taste and good protein, but you save about 300 kcal.

faq.a: Usually yes. The patty and bun are fried on a griddle with margarine, and lots of sauce is added. You can ask for less margarine and sauce.

faq.q: Is the burger patty real meat?
faq.a: Patties are usually minced beef with fat, salt and seasoning. Cheaper patties may contain flour or fillers.

faq.q: Can I eat burgers while building muscle?
faq.a: Yes. A double burger has about 40 g protein. Just watch the total calories and fat so it fits your goals.
